summary_en: 70,000 shares (1.5% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,810/share; aggregate limit ¥126.7M; execution on 2026-07-24 during morning session. Stated purpose: flexible capital policy implementation and financial strategy in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice of Share Acquisition and Share Purchase via Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 23 July 2026, Micron Machinery's board approved the acquisition of up to 70,000 shares (1.5% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) via off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The purchase is to be executed on 24 July 2026 during the morning session at the prior day's closing price of ¥1,810/share, with an aggregate limit of ¥126.7M. The order is valid only for the designated trading time and will not be transferred to other trading systems. Results will be announced immediately after the close of trading. The company states the acquisition serves to enable flexible capital policy execution and financial strategy in response to changing business conditions. As of 31 May 2026, the company held 3,088,198 treasury shares (including 246,779 shares held in trust for director and employee equity plans) against 4,617,902 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
